units.source_text: 十月初，薰中纳言想起宇治的鱼梁上风景正好，便劝请匂亲王前往观赏红叶。

en.t: At the beginning of the tenth month, Kaoru Chūnagon remembered how beautiful the scenery was around the fish weirs at Uji, and invited Prince Niou to go there to view the autumn leaves.

units.source_text: 随从者只是亲王所亲近的人，以及殿上人中亲王所嘉许的几个人，原拟做小规模旅行。

en.t: The attendants were meant to be only those close to the prince and a few courtiers whom the prince favored, for the plan was to make a small excursion.

units.source_text: 然而皇子的威势极盛，这消息自然广泛传播。

en.t: However, the imperial prince's prestige was at its height, so the news naturally spread far and wide.

units.source_text: 于是左大臣夕雾的公子宰相中将也来参加了。

en.t: Thus the Counselor Captain, a son of Yūgiri the Minister of the Left, also came to join them.

units.source_text: 但其中高级官员只有这宰相中将和薰中纳言二人，此外僚属则人数甚多。

en.t: Among the senior officials, however, there were only this Counselor Captain and Kaoru Chūnagon, while the other retainers were very numerous.
